boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other

cards.title: The Puck
cards.subtitle: Outdoor space near South Mall, Missouri S&T

cards.title: Missouri S&T Stonehenge

cards.source_title: Outdoor Spaces — Events and Hospitality Management, Missouri S&T
cards.access_notes: Outdoor landmark; event access and setup can vary.
